exposure: duration of pregnancy less than 37 weeks
cohort: The study included 346,874 live births registered in a population-based information system.
finding: The prevalence of congenital malformations was 1.0%, and factors positively associated included duration of pregnancy less than 37 weeks (OR = 1.17), singleton pregnancy (OR = 1.775), and number of prenatal consultations inferior to six (OR = 1.214).
mod_finding: Type of delivery was found to be negatively associated with congenital malformations (OR = 0.827).
